title: BPW-2026-0579
text:
[BUREAU OF ENGINEERING]
BPW-2026-0579
CD 14
REVISED TASK ORDER SOLICITATION (TOS) NO. 84 – ARCADIS U.S., INC. (ARCADIS)
Recommending the Board:
AUTHORIZE the City Engineer to issue a revision of the task for TOS No. 84 to Arcadis, increasing the budget authority from $849,342 to $1,054,000 for pre-design, design, and design support services during construction for the San Pascual Pumping Plant No. 605 Rehabilitation Project.
(W.O.: SZC14386, C-129644)
summary: Increases the budget for Arcadis U.S., Inc.'s design and construction-support contract for the San Pascual Pumping Plant No. 605 rehabilitation in Council District 14, from $849,342 to $1,054,000.
